rule: HS is the spine; these are its limbs. An outside tool's output is evidence, never authority (docs/INTEGRATION_STACK.md). Each tool is measured before HS relies on it; licences decide whether it is copied in, run separately or only read.

tools.name: FreeRouting
tools.how: run as a separate program (jar)
tools.measured: HS's first router; HS-BUS-A 2 of 5 runs DRC-clean

tools.name: Copper (copper-kicad-mcp)
tools.how: run in KiCad 10's container; pipeline fallback and hs_route_copper
tools.measured: HS-BUS-A 5 of 5 clean; designers' boards 1 of 3 clean

tools.name: KiCadRoutingTools
tools.how: run as a separate program in its own environment; route.py with the board's net-class widths (its autorouter caps power nets at 0.3 mm); pipeline fallback after FreeRouting, before Copper
tools.measured: 3 of 3 designer boards fully connected (Copper 2 of 3), fewer added errors; HS-BUS-A clean in 49 s with 2.5/1.2 mm power tracks

tools.name: KiCad ERC and DRC (kicad-cli)
tools.how: run as a separate program; KiCad 10 through scripts/kicad10-cli
